notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
Halana and Alena has at least three power.
Opponents can not block and kill Najeela.
description:
Move to combat.
Halana and Alena trigger, putting at least three +1/+1 counters on Cryptic Trilobite.
Attack with at least Najeela.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Najeela by paying {5}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
